dialogues.speaker: Viktor Vance
dialogues.text: They thought they scrubbed your memory banks clean and left you for scrap in Sector Zero. But your cyberware is still ticking. Wake up, kid. We've got a city to burn.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Neural link established. Visual cortex calibrated. Stand up, operative. The clinic security grid has been compromised.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Emergency klaxons active. Accelerate into a sprint towards the pressurized airlock.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Blast door closing. Build forward momentum and slide beneath the hydraulic gate.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor Vance
dialogues.text: Don't let debris slow you down! Vault straight over those concrete barriers—keep that flow going.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor Vance
dialogues.text: Toxic coolant leak ahead. Don't look down, kid! Hit the left wall at speed—your mag-boots will catch the plating.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Elevator shaft blocked. Jump between the opposing walls in rapid succession to gain vertical altitude.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: High ventilation gantry detected. Jump towards the edge to mantle onto the catwalk.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Syndicate combat drone detected. Draw your blade. Time your parry exactly as its optic flashes crimson to shatter its posture.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor Vance
dialogues.text: Pick up that Smart Pistol from the weapon rack. Lock onto the three surveillance sensors overhead and drop 'em.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Camera telemetry operational. Press V to switch between first-person focus and third-person tactical situational awareness.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: You earned Agility experience from those maneuvers. Press K to access your neural skills interface and inspect your progression.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor Vance
dialogues.text: Hook onto that zipline! Welcome to Neo-Veridia, kid. The real work starts now.
